# Design Related

> > A design-focused platform exploring creative careers, workspace solutions, and practical lifestyle optimization through strategic design thinking.

Design Related is curated by Miriam, a design professional sharing insights on career development, work-life balance, and design applications across residential and commercial spaces. The site features both personal perspectives on creative careers and practical guides on design-related topics from partner contributors.

## Key Topics

- Design Career
- Work-Life Balance
- Creative Professional
- Workspace Organization
- Commercial Real Estate
- Asset Protection
- Flexible Storage Solutions
- Business Scalability
- Learning and Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- Lifestyle Design
- Financial Freedom
- Inventory Management
- Office Space Management

## About & Author

- [About - Design Related](https://designrelated.com/about): Miriam's personal bio: designer, career journey, work-life balance
